description: This file defines a class 'MacroCallParameterIntegerValueMatcher' that extends Hamcrest's TypeSafeMatcher to match objects against an integer value, primarily used for testing purposes within the macro rendering framework in Apache OFBiz.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterIntegerValueMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher class extending TypeSafeMatcher to verify if an object equals a specific integer value.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterIntegerValueMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matcher with a specific integer value to match against.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks if the provided object equals the specified integer value.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a description of the matcher, indicating the expected integer value.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Describes the mismatch when the object does not match the expected value.
